edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer source in transfer().
msg.sender is used as approver in transferFrom().
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve().
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the source account.
manualswap authorizes the caller by direct address equality instead of a modifier.
manualsend authorizes the caller by direct address equality instead of a modifier.
blockBots is gated by the onlyOwner modifier checking msg.sender.
setTrading is gated by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold is gated by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
toggleSwap is gated by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
setMaxWalletSize is gated by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees is gated by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
onlyOwner compares the stored owner against the caller before setTrading executes.
onlyOwner compares the stored owner before blockBots executes.
onlyOwner compares the stored owner before fee exclusion executes.
_developmentAddress is one of two privileged callers of manualswap.
_developmentAddress is one of two privileged callers of manualsend.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call before final balance settlement.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee which performs a native ETH transfer.
swapTokensForEth calls the external router, giving control to an untrusted contract.
swapTokensForEth reads the uniswapV2Router state variable for the call target.
sendETHToFee triggers a native transfer that can reenter the contract.
sendETHToFee sends funds to the privileged _marketingAddress.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making execution miner-dependent.
block.timestamp feeds the deadline argument of the external router call.
_transfer delegates final settlement to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to move reflections.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to credit the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to burn reflections.
_rOwned balances are added/subtracted with SafeMath inside _transferStandard.
_rTotal is reduced by the fee amount in _reflectFee.
_isExcludedFromFee determines whether fees are taken in _transfer.
tradingOpen gates who may send tokens in _transfer.
bots blacklist blocks transfers in _transfer.
_maxTxAmount constrains the transfer amount in _transfer.
_maxWalletSize constrains recipient balances in _transfer.
_swapTokensAtAmount drives the automatic swap decision in _transfer.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap branch in _transfer.
inSwap guard prevents recursive swap entry from _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to detect trades in _transfer.
transfer routes into _transfer.
transferFrom routes into _transfer.
approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom decrements and reads _allowances for authorization.
blockBots writes the bots blacklist mapping.
setTrading writes the tradingOpen gate.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold writes the swap threshold.
toggleSwap writes the swapEnabled flag.
setMaxWalletSize writes the wallet cap.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes fee exemptions.
manualswap triggers the external swap path.
manualsend triggers the native ETH transfer path.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is a parameter of the transfer function and has no standalone semantic identity.
amount is a parameter of the transfer function and should be folded into it.
sender is a parameter of transferFrom and only meaningful within that function.
amount is a parameter of transferFrom and only meaningful within that function.
from is a parameter of the internal _transfer routine.
to is a parameter of the internal _transfer routine.
amount is a parameter of the internal _transfer routine.
bots_ is the parameter array of blockBots and maps directly to that function.
notbot is a single-address parameter of the blacklist management flow.
accounts is the parameter array of excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees.
contractTokenBalance is a transient local used only inside _transfer.
canSwap is a transient local used only inside _transfer.
takeFee is a transient local controlling fee logic inside _transfer.
